scribe_mix.text: [upbeat music] Fractions, fractions, parts of a whole. Top number, numerator. Bottom number, denominator. A portion, a section of any quantity. [upbeat music] The whole, an object or a group of objects. Cut a piece of cake. The portion, the fraction of the cake. Fraction, a word originated from Latin. Fractus means broken, broken. In ancient times, represented using words, later introduced in numerical form. [upbeat music] Denoted by the symbol a over b, two over four. The upper part, numerator. The lower part, denominator. Top number, selected or shaded parts of a whole. Bottom number, the total number of parts. Fractions, fractions, parts of a whole. Top number, numerator. Bottom number, denominator. A portion, a section of any quantity. [upbeat music] A number divided into four parts, x over four, one-fourth of the number x, one in four equal parts, one-fourth, one-fourth. Fractions play an important part in our daily lives. Share that yummy pizza, friends and families. Three people, four slices. Slice an apple into two equal parts, each part one over two, one over two. [upbeat music] Two parts of fractions, numerator and denominator. The upper part, the sections of the fraction. Denominator, the bottom part, the total parts in which the fraction is divided. Three over four. Three, numerator. Four, denominator. [upbeat music] Fractions.
